title: From Mumbai to Guwahati: Adani to invest $2.1 billion in airport city projects spanning over 655 acres
summary: The expansion will span the cities of Mumbai and its suburb of Navi Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Lucknow, Jaipur, and Guwahati, with around 22 million square feet of mixed-use infrastructure planned in the initial phase, Adani Airport Holdings Ltd. said in a statement Thursday.
